setup_guide.introduction: Each run watches live security logs on this Mac for up to two minutes. Open the finished report to see the assessment, supporting events and any gaps in coverage.

real.introduction: Use the default report folder or choose another destination. I read the live logs available to your current account when you start a run.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Folder for the web report and evidence from each live observation.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll watch new security events on this Mac for up to two minutes, then assess the evidence available to your account.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the Mac security report and start with Assessment. Follow an issue to Evidence and check Coverage for gaps.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open report.md in the output folder to review the assessment, supporting events and coverage.

web_ui.title: Mac security report
web_ui.description: Review the assessment, supporting log events and coverage from a completed live observation.
